name: cache-keeper
description: Shows whether the prompt cache is warm, keeps it warm while that is cheaper, and asks before a cold send.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a hit: 5m (default) or 1h.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: api shows dollars; subscription shows tokens and % of a cold rewrite.

priceTable.title: Price table (JSON)
priceTable.description: USD per million tokens, keyed by a substring of the model id: {"opus":{"input":4,"write5m":5,"write1h":8,"read":0.2}}. Verify against current pricing.

gateUsd.title: Cold-send gate threshold (USD)
gateUsd.description: Hold a prompt when the cache is cold and the rewrite would cost more than this. 0 turns the gate off.

gateTokens.title: Cold-send gate threshold (tokens)
gateTokens.description: On a subscription, or a model with no price row: hold when the cold rewrite is larger than this. 0 turns the gate off.

keepAlive.title: Keep-alive ping
keepAlive.description: While idle, ping the cache just before it expires, until the pings would cost more than one cold rewrite.

maxIdleMinutes.title: Keep-alive max idle (minutes)
maxIdleMinutes.description: Stop pinging after this long without a prompt.

preCompact.title: Compact before it goes cold
preCompact.description: When the keep-alive is about to stop: offer a compaction while still warm, run it, or do nothing.
